spatial_model: 10 physically modeled room spaces (9 ground-floor cells plus elevated attic), true traversable doorways, first-person W/A/S/D navigation, 24 interactive authored sculptures with Poly Haven artist donor geometries mounted in scene on room entry

clock.policy: House owns fictional time: +3 minutes per changed room, +6 per observation. Stair ascension is one changed room. Parent Elisium sky unchanged.

state.persistence: sessionStorage on same origin; export manual
state.shared_with_parent: allowlisted, explicit nonprivate discovery signals only

rendering.artist_models: 20 distinct current Poly Haven 1k glTF donors for 24 authored objects, fetched lazily on entering each room; original procedural fantasy sculptures persist if assets fail
rendering.room_geometry: original procedural timber framing, wallpaper, wooden floors, stone/window glass and warm light, no donor world geometry
rendering.visitor_controls: WASD and arrows + pointer drag; E inspect/ascend; accessible room index and touch buttons
rendering.performance: room-local original model fetching with slug deduplication and memory caching
rendering.status: implemented; awaiting browser visual and navigation acceptance

object_presentation.positions: stable room-owned plinth coordinates derived from placeForObject(room,index)
object_presentation.historic_donors: Poly Haven CC0 live source model geometry inside house; no longer isolated in an inspection panel
object_presentation.fantasy_art: house-fantasy.mjs original bespoke physically animated objects with distinct activations
object_presentation.journals: sessionStorage only; no automatic visitor identity or persistence across sessions

status: playable physically navigable 3D house with 24 story-bearing objects; parent independent sky integration still deferred

parent_integration_candidate.mode: iframe pocket world retains running native 4.6 parent
parent_integration_candidate.handoff: one-time explicit object IDs and bounded local minutes
parent_integration_candidate.authority: parent owns sky and land routes, child owns rooms and journals
parent_integration_candidate.limitations: Native game time not reconciled; no server or persisted identity; no child code overwritten
